questions.name: q1_what_can_i_do
questions.question: What can I do at Engineer Cafe?
questions.answer: At Engineer Cafe, you can attend events, work in the coworking area, or use the fabrication lab on B1F. You can also rent equipment, access a book library, and enjoy drinks and refreshments.

questions.name: q2_where_is_toilet
questions.question: Where is the toilet?
questions.answer: The toilet is located at the back of the terrace on the 1F. You need to go through the passage behind the reception desk to reach it.

questions.name: q3_cafe_open_weekend
questions.question: Is the cafe open on weekends?
questions.answer: Yes, the cafe is open on weekends. It operates on Saturday and Sunday with both day and night time hours.
